info.name: WorkBoard External Public Activity (Action Items) Activity (Action Items) Metric (Key Result) API
Request metrics (key results) the user (token owner) has access to. Use a Data-Admin token to gain access to metrics across your organization.

params.name: metric_id
params.description: The unique numerical id assigned to each metric in WorkBoard. Include the metric_id parameter in the request to limit the response to a specific metric.

params.name: goal_id
params.description: The unique numerical id assigned to each goal in WorkBoard. Include this parameter to return metrics from the specified goal only.

params.name: team_id
params.description: The unique numerical id assigned to each team in WorkBoard. Include this parameter to return metrics belonging to the specified team.

params.name: include_metric_data
params.description: Include this parameter to indicate whether to include metric data for charts in the response. This will also include any metric comments.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of team metrics returned per page when used with `team_id`. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 15.

params.name: offset
params.description: Specify the starting point for the number of team metrics returned when used with `team_id`. Permitted values are integers greater than or equal to 0. The default value is 0.

items.docs: By default, when no additional parameters are passed, this returns the Metrics the token owner has ownership of. If the token owner doesn't own any Metrics, the results will be empty.

params.name: force_update
params.description: Set to `yes` to force the update through. This allows updating closed metrics, metrics on closed objectives, metrics on objectives that have passed their target date, and applying updates to previous data points via `update_start_date` and `update_end_date` that fall outside the objective's time period.

items.docs: Update progress of an individual metric. If you do not include the `metric_data_id` parameter, the value will be applied to the most recent update date according to the metric update frequency set in WorkBoard.

info.name: Update the confidence score (RAG) of a metric (key result)

params.name: metric_id_path
params.description: The unique metric_id to each metric.

items.docs:
Update the confidence score and comment on a metric. The confidence_score values map to: 0 = No Rating, 1 = Low, 2 = Medium, 3 = High.

This would appear as a separate confidence update in the Metric history and not a progress update with a confidence update.

**Note:** The metric must be in an active state. Attempting to update confidence on a deleted metric will result in a 500 error with the message "deleted_metric".
